topic: Sound, video monitors and mixer tables
summary: A 55 in TV rental on a wheeled stand: screen about 49 in wide by 28.5 in high (1.25 x 0.72 m), under 3.5 in deep, 22 to 36 lb; the trolley raises it to roughly 63 to 75 in overall (about 1.6 to 1.9 m) and rents for roughly $250 to $300 a day plus delivery. Planners need an outlet and an HDMI run, and should keep cables off walkways. A DJ or front-of-house table is a 6 ft x 2 ft steel-frame deck table, 36 to 40 in high (1.83 x 0.61 x about 0.95 m), roughly 150 lb, with room for a controller, mixer and laptop; allow power strips and a skirt. A popular compact PA is a 12 in powered speaker (QSC K12.2: 23.7 x 14 x 13.8 in, 39 lb, 2000 W, two 35 mm pole sockets) on a tripod stand, usually a pair flanking the performance area, with a stand adding about 4 to 5 ft so the cabinet sits above guests' heads; each speaker needs its own mains power and an XLR run.
